proofs.text: Run the gate at gate `recorded` over a record committed under the build identity; verify it exits 0 and prints `gate = recorded`
Run the gate at gate `recorded` over a record a person committed; verify it exits 1, opens `Not recorded (2):` and gives the reason `no record CI wrote covers this commit`

reasons: PROOF-34 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.

rule_text: At gate `recorded` only a record CI committed counts, and a record a person committed is reported as no record at all

tests.body:
def test_a_record_ci_committed_passes(self):
        made = project_at('recorded')
        try:
            code, output = run(made)
            assert code == 0, output
            assert 'verify-gate: gate = recorded' in output
        finally:
            made.close()
tests.name: test_a_record_ci_committed_passes

tests.body:
def test_a_developer_record_does_not_count(self):
        made = project_at('recorded', by_ci=False)
        try:
            code, output = run(made)
            assert code == 1
            assert 'Not recorded (2):' in output
            assert 'no record CI wrote covers this commit' in output
        finally:
            made.close()
tests.name: test_a_developer_record_does_not_count
